task.description: Applied REQ-237's .zig provenance-marking convention to chunk 239h: docs/issues/*.yaml, ISS-0101 through ISS-0439 (the subset of that range carrying a .zig reference). Re-derived the file list fresh (grep -l '\.zig' over ISS-0101..ISS-0439 range) rather than trusting the requirement's draft-time count, and it matched the 11 draft-time-named files exactly: ISS-0101, ISS-0102, ISS-0103, ISS-0104, ISS-0105, ISS-0278, ISS-0402, ISS-0411, ISS-0424, ISS-0438, ISS-0439. For each .zig citation, inserted the marker line 'PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority):' immediately above its smallest enclosing citation unit (a folded-scalar paragraph bounded by blank lines/field start, per the design doc's structural rule) -- 23 markers total across 11 files. One marker (ISS-0424, preceding its title: key, whose value contains a .zig substring) used the YAML-comment-prefixed shape from the design doc's ISS-0510 amendment, since a bare prose line directly above a top-level key would corrupt YAML syntax; all other insertions sit inside description/resolution/resolution_note/scoping_note/diagnosis_note/source folded (>) scalars where a bare prose line is syntactically safe. No .zig citation text was altered, reordered, or deleted -- every insertion is a pure added line. Committed on this branch as 68ccfc04.
